text:
You miss breakthrough ideas because you're half asleep.

Rhine tested this at Duke. People in two states. Alert. Drowsy.

Alert? Ideas flooded in.

Drowsy? Nothing.

The man who catches the idea that changes everything isn't lucky. He was awake.

You're walking around at 60% consciousness. Coffee hits. You hit 70%. That's when you get a flash. Then you slip back down to half asleep.

The top 1% stay sharp all day. That's it.

Get sharp. Stay there.
caption:
You think you're missing success opportunities. Really, you're running on idle with a numb mind.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
